facts.fact: Tafsela reports that the Hadayek El Kobba prosecution ordered a suspect held four days pending investigation for using AI to doctor images from the Interior Ministry's official page and reposting them for views and profit.
facts.system: Hadayek El Kobba prosecution detention order
